title: My Desired Home
description: East-facing 60 × 55 ft home: garden-facing care suite, compact rear caregiver suite and lawn, rear veranda, longer parking approach, separate drawing room with three doors and a double-height family living hall.

title: My Desired Home · Inside the Wires
description: A separate copy of the veranda house with an interactive, India-focused electrical tour. Explore the meter, boards, protected circuits and concealed route traces.

title: The Bungalow
description: A large 100 × 130 ft G+1 government bungalow recreated from the owner's photographs: red comb-frieze parapets, a grilled entrance verandah beside a corrugated carport, a grand drawing hall and dining hall in teak and cane, four bedrooms, ceiling fans and 3.6 m ceilings, a big clipped lawn, rose-covered fences, neem, mango and Ashoka trees.

title: The Aangan House
description: A single-storey courtyard home on a 55 × 80 ft plot: every room opens to an aangan with a mango tree. Opens as its own drawing; scroll to walk in.

title: The Long House
description: A G+1 home on a 30 × 60 ft plot laid on one line: living, a light court open to the sky, dining, kitchen and garden. Opens as its own drawing; scroll to walk in.

title: Your saved Verandah House
description: The design you saved, with broad balconies, bright interiors and an accessible roof terrace.

title: The original Verandah House
description: The familiar startup home: tropical planting, shaded balconies and a furnished roof terrace.

title: The Garden Pavilion
description: A warm, earthy two-bedroom home on one level, with relaxed living and a compact garden.

title: The Quiet Studio
description: A compact one-bedroom home with a pale palette and calm, minimal interiors.

title: The Palm Terrace Villa
description: A larger four-bedroom family home with deep shade, warm interiors and roof access.

title: My Desired Home · original 50 × 50 ft

title: Tirumala

options.label: A — Original flow
options.tag: Balanced care room and a 5½′ rear veranda
options.trade: Closest overall flow; 5½′ veranda between care and the compact caregiver room.

options.label: B — Larger care suite
options.trade: Largest revised care suite (224.5 sq ft). The 3½′ rear veranda is a circulation strip; seating sits in the wider northwest pocket.

options.label: C — Garden first
options.trade: Deepest main veranda bay: 6½′, with a 4½′ left return. The side passage is the same slim 3′ width as every option.

options.label: D — Larger drawing room
options.trade: Drawing is a plain 11′ × 12′ rectangle. A, B, C and E use a shorter 11′ × 10′ rectangle. All share the same shallow front porch.

options.label: E — Caregiver courtyard
options.tag: 5′ shared veranda court · caregiver opposite care
options.trade: Care and caregiver face a shared 5′ veranda court. A west-side return connects the hall to the rear strip.

description: East-facing 40 × 50 ft (2,000 sq ft) northeast corner home (Revision 10, Options A–E) bounded by a 12 m North road (opposite a colony garden and white/blue-grey house) and a 9 m East road (opposite a basketball-court enclosure): corner L staircase, enlarged kitchen and west dining, two upper master suites and a generous family lounge, with ~23 ft double-height void and rooflight, shallow 11 × 3 ft open porch, +300 mm house/court/veranda datum above a ±0 mm 10.5 × 19 ft car bay, South-to-North care bed with broad North/East glazing, caregiver suite, and open NW garden.

title: Tirumala 2
description: 40 × 50 ft east-facing G+1 home. Home ICU 11′7¾″ × 14′11″, 158.6 sq ft. Notched ICU extended 1½ ft south into open living, with compact closed storage; front veranda and empty drawing room. Living–veranda door remains 3 ft 5⅝ in clear between jambs. Soft ivory floors, lighter ceilings, neutral-warm lighting and true-scale room views. Kitchen, wash gully, stairs, master suite, veranda, lower parking porch and upper enclosed rooms retained. Upper master suite, office, guest bedroom, double-height gallery and open terrace; ivory, teak and limestone finishes.

title: Tirumala 3

Soft ivory floors, lighter ceilings, neutral-warm lighting and true-scale room views. Kitchen, wash gully, stairs, master suite, veranda, lower parking porch and upper enclosed rooms retained. Upper master suite, office, guest bedroom, double-height gallery and open terrace; ivory, teak and limestone finishes.

title: Tirumala 4
description: 40 × 50 ft east-facing G+1 northeast corner home built on locked Tirumala 3 (P13) geometry (Home ICU 11′3″ × 13′4⅞″, 150.8 sq ft, 5 ft east forecourt, layered wood + sliding glass ICU entrance, 15 ft 7⅝ in × 7 ft 0¼ in north veranda, 23 ft double-height living void, upper master, study, guest room & open terrace). Calibrated Tirumala Colony surroundings from site photos R07–R14 and walk-around video V01–V06, empty private car porch by default (with optional parking check), Existing-vs-Proposed site toggle, and balanced warm-daylight & neutral-overcast ivory–limestone–teak interiors. Refined ivory/limestone boundary, low natural leaf planting without red blocks, edged grass pockets and slimmer streetlights. My Desired Home exterior wall/glazing treatment; owner-confirmed vacant adjoining grass lots.
style: Ivory · limestone · teak (P13 · calibrated colony & interior realism)
